decisions.reason: The hand-knotted wool silk carpet is a premium showpiece that fits the craftsmanship positioning and costs little to keep listed, so the option stays open while its value is still being revealed.
Two similar low-pile carpets were already dropped, which suggests this segment is weaker, but holding the surviving variant is cheap, so it stays one more period before its value is judged.
The corner bench extends the established upholstery and dining offer for residential and hospitality projects at low incremental cost, so further time on the market is justified.
The multi-model swivel shell chair line serves both contract and residential demand, and it remains a valuable option to scale as demand uncertainty resolves.
